def _create_pending_order(event, code, expires, **kwargs):
    return Order.objects.create(
        code=code, event=event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
        status=Order.STATUS_PENDING, locale='en',
        datetime=now(), expires=expires,
        total=Decimal('23.00'),
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        **kwargs
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_sent_within_window(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    o = _create_pending_order(event, 'EXP1', now() + timedelta(days=2))
    send_expiry_warnings(sender=event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['dummy@dummy.test']
    assert o.code in djmail.outbox[0].subject
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.expiry_reminder_sent
    assert o.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.email.expire_warning_sent').exists()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_not_sent_outside_window(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    o = _create_pending_order(event, 'EXP1', now() + timedelta(days=5))
    send_expiry_warnings(sender=event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert not o.expiry_reminder_sent


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_disabled_with_zero_days(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 0
    o = _create_pending_order(event, 'EXP1', now() + timedelta(days=2))
    send_expiry_warnings(sender=event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert not o.expiry_reminder_sent


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_sent_only_once(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    _create_pending_order(event, 'EXP1', now() + timedelta(days=2))
    send_expiry_warnings(sender=event)
    send_expiry_warnings(sender=event)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_skips_already_expired_order(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    _create_pending_order(event, 'EXP1', now() - timedelta(hours=1))
    send_expiry_warnings(sender=event)

    send_expiry_warnings(sender=event)

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_skips_order_with_cancellation_fee(event):
